notes.title: Added Full Controller Support and AI opponents
notes.content:
This major update takes up many issues, but let´s begin with the most important and requested issue by you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085560/886d3dfe6c8bf3b072c0a2c25563b55c5ed13a07.png[/img]


[h3]Full Controller Support[/h3]
The Flow Gear Racing control system has been switched completely from slope steering to full controller supported controls, which enables a more immersive experience to control your ship including brake and turbo booster. Also the track builder has been switched to full controller support. The default controller bindings have been updated for the most common controllers. The controller support is fully compatible to the Steam VR Input System. So you can customize your controller bindings or add your own controllers in the SteamVR settings as usual:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085560/7efe71b051710a1189b1b6585016f24e3415f3f5.png[/img]
So you can look around freely in cockpit while in race. [b]The days of headache are gone! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085560/afb655862daf2973e738ca23d4fffbd1caf7952d.png[/img]

Another major issue addresses the single player mode: 
[h3]Race against AI opponents and your best time ghost racer[/h3]
From now on you compete against six other AI opponents with different skill levels. Additionally you have to beat your own best time not only on the leaderboards but against your ghost racer as well, which represents your best track time so far.

Further issues addressed:
[h3]User Interface / Head Up Display[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reordered the race tracks menu according to their increasing level of difficulty
[*] Ingame Head Up Display has been attached to the ship for better overview instead moving it with your head direction
[*] New flight controls described in "How To Play"
[*] External camera views, orientation and movement controls have been updated. Moves were smoothed to prevent motion sickness
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085560/e46d9e2af7deee3089952f84724fb52271429322.png[/img]
[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Color correction performed for more a more intense experience
[*] Improved anti aliasing in the VR environment
[/list]
[h3]Music / Sound FX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ingame music has been added and the possibility to turn music off in the preferences as well, when you only want to listen to Sound FX
[/list]
[h3]Other Fixes and polishing[/h3]
[list]
[*] The global leaderboard entries are now displayed player-centered 
[*] The demo version has also been updated to get the new flight experience
[/list]

notes.title: User Interface Input Update & Graphics Polishing
notes.content:
We take up some issues mentioned in the Early Access road map and changed the legacy gaze input based input system into a more intuitive controller based laser pointer menu navigation. 

The ingame scenes got a polish due to lighting updates and improved shading, so that they appear more realistic. The cover image contains the lightning before the update on the left side and after the update on the right side, so you can see the difference. 

A fix for a rare occurring ship staggering after restart ingame is also delivered. Have a look at the details:

[h3]User interface improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The legacy gaze pointer has been replaced with a controller based laserpointer.
[*] Visualizing VR controllers, which implies updated controller bindings
[*] Better contrasting hover and press of the menubuttons against the background
[/list]
[h3]Graphical ingame improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Higher resolution skyboxes and textures
[*] Updated shaders for better lighting and reflections of the respective material
[*] More intensive direct lights, lightmaps updated
[*] normal maps adjustments, e.g. the ships surfaces are defined less bumpy
[*] Planet Earth is now visible in the titlescreen to the left, rearranged ships
[/list]
[h3]Misc.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Sometimes staggering after restart at last gate
[/list]

notes.title: Extended Controls Update - Ver. 1.0.0-1924-beta
notes.content:
If you are having issues with tangling cables while flying, the new extended steering controls will eliminate the need to turn your head during flight. Furthermore, you can now recenter your view at any time in the game.

[h2]Details[/h2]

[h3]Slope Steering[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slope Steering is now available in race and in the track builder (recommended for corded headsets)
[*] Optionally it can be switched off via the settings menu, but it is enabled by default
[*] Saves the setting in the player preferences
[/list]
[h3]Recenter View[/h3]
[list]
[*] Recenter View is usable at any time via controller button, in game and in track builder
[*] Also Automatic Recenter View when switching to main menu, at race start and at continue in game 
[*] Default controller bindings for Recenter View created 
[/list]
[h3]Misc.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Default HP Motion Controller bindings created
[*] How To Play page updated
[/list]

notes.title: Wrangling cords issue - Getting fixed with the next update!
notes.content:
Not all pilots have their cords mounted overhead.
So if you experience problems while racing with wrangling cords:
We are working on an extended control setup which specifically addresses this issue and should fix it.
It comes with our next update, which should be available mid-april.
And the Demo version will get the update as well.
